aggregate.metric: utility = -fitness of argmin-predicted pool program (-2.0 on gate fail); higher is better
aggregate.strict_rule: pooled OOF gain > 0.002 AND gain CI low > 0 AND pooled Elo > 0 AND Elo CI low > 0 AND non-floor Elo CI low > 0 AND Elo > 0 on each partition; selection = max mean non-floor OOF Elo over partitions
